architectural_file: Pages from 200 W. Highland Construction Plans - Complete.pdf
dimension_source: A2.03, Level R1 Plan & RCP, uploaded page 1, 04-02-07
elevation_source: A3.11, building sections 01 and 02, uploaded page 9, 04-02-07
method: Transfer dimensioned common structural grid from A2.03 to P2.02; register the P4.01 Unit A crop to P2.02 using shared architectural features. A2.03 is not Unit A's architectural plan.
uncertainty_basis: Conservative working allowances for raster line picking, cross-sheet registration and simplified manual route tracing; not survey accuracy or statistical confidence limits.
roof_note: 404.42 is a top-of-plate reference, not a uniform roof surface. A3.11 also shows 406.00, 406.58 and 413.17 at other locations.
elevation_note: Use the explicitly labeled floor elevations. Some vertical interval notes add (+1/4 inch), which is not represented by the decimal elevation differences; retain this discrepancy pending architectural clarification.
unit_overhead_pipe_basis: No drawing gives domestic-water pipe elevations. Heights are assumed, keeping 2 in separations, and placed inside the documented overhead band (unit_107_ceiling.overhead_band_in): above the highest documented finished ceiling and below the lowest documented drop-slab soffit. Superseded 102/100/98 in placed HWC below the derived hallway and living-room ceilings.
ceiling_note: Eleven feet is floor-to-floor, not clear ceiling height. Clear heights are derived in unit_107_ceiling from the structural R1 soffit elevations and the A7.63 ceiling drops; explicit water-pipe elevations remain unavailable.

unit_107_ceiling.datum: P1 finished floor 342.00 ft (A2.02 +342.00; A3.11 P1 LEVEL +342.00). Heights are inches above that floor.

r1_top_of_slab_ft.source: S3.7 details 2/5/15, PDF page 17; agrees with A3.11 R1 +353.00

r1_bottom_of_band_beam_ft.beams: R1-B11 to R1-B14, grid G (north side of Unit 107)

structure.band_beam_size: 72 in wide, depth varies (16 in min), S3.4 schedule 20, PDF page 14
structure.note: Top of slab slopes down up to 2-3 in toward exterior per architectural; bottom-of-slab and bottom-of-beam elevations are level. Soffit strips on S2.3 (PDF page 4) are 'soffit per plan' and their depths are not resolved here.

unit_107_ceiling.drop_datum_rule: A7.63 RCP legend note 01: soffit depths are taken from bottom of slab or drop slab, whichever is lower. Drops are therefore applied to the drop-slab (band beam) bottom, 351.21 ft. Measuring from bottom of slab (351.88 ft) instead would raise each ceiling by 8 in; that reading is not adopted.
unit_107_ceiling.drops_source: A7.63 RCP: Unit 107 (Unit A), full-set PDF page 126, 2007-04-02, Addendum 1 2007-05-01
unit_107_ceiling.drops_note: A7.63 states each drop as +/-. Master WIC is shaded low dropped ceiling without a dimension. Other rooms carry no drop callout.

overhead_band_in.basis: min = highest derived finished ceiling (living/dining); max = lowest documented drop-slab bottom (351.13 ft = 109.56 in). Pipe centerline +/- half nominal bore must stay inside.

unit_107_ceiling.open_items: RFI 99, ASI 54 and RFI 245 (ceiling heights), RFI 344 (drop header heights @ kitchen), RFI 201 (ceiling assemblies @ plenums) and RFI 366 (plenum insulation) revised these conditions; their responses are not in the supplied documents and govern over this derivation.

p1.source: P2.2, Level P1 Plumbing Plan, full-set PDF page 183, 09-28-06, reference only / separate permit
p1.architecture_source: A2.02, Level P1 Plan & RCP, full-set PDF page 46, 04-02-07
p1.scope: South residential corridor CW/HW/HWC mains and Unit 107 service approach
p1.overhead_pipe_basis: Assumed; matched to the Unit 107 heights so the approach meets the unit at the same level. P1 corridor ceilings are not derived, so the Unit 107 band check does not apply to this scene.
